baseline.convention: sqrt(pi r / (2c)) elliptic group operations for an equivalence class of c elements, negation included. The cost model's sqrt(pi r / 4) (jacobian_transfer::cost) is the c = 2 case, so a class enters as sqrt(c / 2); certificate v1 divided that reference by sqrt(c), counted negation twice and sat 0.5 bit low (Amendment 3). isogeny_degree_search::rho_reference uses sqrt(pi r / 2) (no equivalence class), a factor sqrt 2 higher, and is not used
baseline.equivalence_class_reason: negation and the 2^1-Frobenius: E is defined over F_(2^1), so classes have size 2*35/1 = 70 (upper bound on the speedup)
